classification.reproducedSignature: Pre-existing production hydration race: same React #418 message, hard bare-profile route and off preference reproduced on main, including a control with no axe injection.
classification.originalEvent: Exact original cause remains unknown. Historical stack, event timestamp and exact event URL were not captured. Later reproductions cannot supply those missing fields.
classification.artifact: Not established as a test artifact: baseline no-axe control failed. Delayed scripts are a timing probe, not the original conditions.
classification.resolution: Not resolved. The final preference guard restores the missing attribute; it does not prevent #418.
classification.development: Distinct nonfatal Court useId/aria-labelledby attribute mismatch also reproduced on baseline. It is not proven to cause production #418.

originalConditions.routeAssociation: Captured failing state after hard page.goto from /playoffs; error-event URL itself was not recorded.
